task: D01 报告文档与 DOCX 导出
description: staged knowledge material -> report.md (editable source) + report.docx (same-run export) + manifest.json
pipeline: read staged material; build the citation set from the material manifest's kc_ ids only
author report.md: title/abstract/3+ sections/long table/trailing sources with kc_ citations
render report.docx from exactly that source with python-docx 1.1.2 (CJK fonts via w:eastAsia, Table Grid tables)
export check re-opens the stored docx and verifies headings/numbers/citations/table/font/rels/UTF-8 against the markdown
manifest.json records headings, citation_ids and the four gate checks

toolchain.fonts_cjk: fonts-noto-cjk 1:20220127+repack1-1 (SIL Open Font License 1.1; from the D02 set)

forbidden: invented citations (kc_ + 24 hex enforced server-side by ValidateDocumentManifest)
shipping a docx without the same-run markdown source
raw HTML in the document view

example.input: two staged knowledge materials (公司介绍资料 + 客户案例资料) with kc_ citation ids
example.round1: 客户介绍 with 3 sections (公司概况/产品能力/实施效果), an 8-row customer table and 2 clickable kc_ citations; numbers 12 客户 / 96% 满意度 / 6 周 交付
example.round2: add a FAQ section keeping 12/96%/6 周 verbatim; old version docx keeps its original SHA
